review.scope: Twelve exact defect/control pairs across seven synthetic and five pinned public repository groups; one Python architecture case is now checked by the analyzer but remains classified unsupported_syntax and excluded from accuracy ratios pending re-adjudication.
review.methodology: Labels were authored from pinned source and seeded mutations before DocGuard output was reviewed. Traceability-only fixture comments were re-adjudicated on 2026-09-14; expected findings and controls were unchanged. Re-run in full, including the pinned public sources, on tool version 0.41.7 on 2026-09-18: comparison PASS with zero regressions and byte-identical metrics. The only case-level change was the Python architecture case moving from applicability unsupported to checked, because the analyzer gained Python import-graph support after 0.38.0; its classification and its exclusion from ratios are unchanged.
review.limitations: Finite scoped cases do not establish exhaustive documentation or detector correctness. Seven of the tool’s finding codes are measured here; the rest carry no benchmark evidence.
review.caveat: Benchmark precision on a deliberately balanced corpus of 12 defect and 12 clean-control cases across 12 repository groups and 12 causal families. This is DocGuard's precision on labelled cases, not the probability that a finding in your repository is real; quote every ratio with its n and Wilson 95% bound.
